products.label: B
products.reason: It is another high-resolution industrial inkjet printer, very close to the firm's prior high-resolution industrial inkjet offering.

products.label: C
products.reason: It is still a high-resolution inkjet printer for industrial use, differing mainly in printhead technology from the earlier inkjet products.

products.label: D
products.reason: Laser marking systems are in the same industrial marking market as the firm's existing coding and marking products, but laser marking itself is a new technology for the company.

products.label: E
products.reason: A compact laser marking cabin is closely tied to industrial marking applications, but it adds a new laser-based workstation/cabin form factor.

products.label: F
products.reason: A lubricant printing system for sheet metal extends the firm's industrial printing capabilities into a new application and material, but still builds on printing for manufacturing customers.
